description: This Business capstone culminates students business, liberal arts, co-curricular, and
experiential learning. Through applied team projects, practitioner engagement, skill development,
and reflection, students synthesize prior experiences; examine how their strengths, values,
character, and leadership capacities shape vocational direction; and develop evidence of learning
through project work, professional materials, and a portfolio. The course concludes with a
presentation, professional narrative, and next-step plan. Offered annually during January term.
Prerequisites:  BUS 110, BUS 225, and BUS 251 or by permission of the instructor.
fullname: Business Capstone: Leadership, Vocation, and Professional Practice
